# r2 script menus: m04_frontier (generated by gen.py; edit gen.py, not this file)
# Each menu: a RAM script at the call site's x,y with that site's message; every row snapped.
# Battle-room menus are drawn in their facility's lobby (the battle rooms run map scripts on entry).
start saves/r2menus_postgame.sav
include ../continue.txt
# the save has never entered the Frontier: skip the Reception Gate's first-visit scene
ev setvar VAR_HAS_ENTERED_BATTLE_FRONTIER, 1; end

# challengeinfo  (BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_hns:178)
warptoloose MAP_BATTLE_FRONTIER_BATTLE_TOWER_LOBBY_HNS 12 9
waitnotask map_name_popup:Task_MapNamePopUpWindow 600
evstart lockall; message 0x@BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge_hns@; waitmessage; multichoice 17, 6, MULTI_CHALLENGEINFO, FALSE; closemessage; releaseall; end
talk challengeinfo_m 40 - Task_HandleMultichoiceInput
snap challengeinfo_r1
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 1 DOWN
snap challengeinfo_r2
seek 8 @menu:sMenu+2@ 2 DOWN
snap challengeinfo_r3
tap B 0
waitctl 900
